project_type: Vite + React 19 + TypeScript SailPoint ISC UI plugin; access graph is a React Flow (@xyflow/react ^12.12) canvas with dagre-based pure scene builders
language: TypeScript (strict, tsc -b), React function components, plain CSS files (no CSS-in-JS)
build_system: Vite 8 + @vitejs/plugin-react + basicSsl (dev server is HTTPS, self-signed, default port 1573 strictPort). npm. Do not touch package.json / package-lock.json (puppeteer-core is installed only with --no-save and removed with `npm ci --ignore-scripts`).
test_framework: vitest (jsdom, globals, css:false, setup src/test/setup.ts stubs ResizeObserver/matchMedia/DOMMatrixReadOnly) + @testing-library/react. jsdom cannot lay out React Flow, so layout/paint claims need the real-browser harness.
build_command: npm run build   (tsc -b && vite build; must have zero type errors)
test_command: npm test   (vitest run). Single file: npx vitest run <path>. Lint: npm run lint (eslint . ; react-hooks v7 forbids setState in effects and ref writes during render; react-refresh forbids non-component exports from component files).

key_patterns: buildAccessScene.ts is pure; node zIndex literal 2 (to export as CARD_Z_INDEX), status edge zIndex 1, reference edge zIndex 0, edge id e:${from}:${to}, status edges have data.reviewStatus and className vc-graph-edge-status vc-graph-edge-<status>, reference edges data.reference. FitOnSceneChange in AccessGraphCanvas.tsx refits in a rAF on [fitKey,width,height,fitView,store] using measureOverlays/computeFitPadding/toFitViewPadding from fitPadding.ts (strip model: each .react-flow__panel overlay is charged to its thinnest side). Derived state is reset with the 'adjust state during render' pattern (prevNodes) because lint forbids setState in effects. AccessNode.tsx drill-down card is <article tabIndex=0 aria-label> wrapped in NodeTooltip; data.reference marks reference nodes, data.interactive marks grid cards. Layout: user and every lane are centered on cross 0, so the user sits at the lane midpoint; canvas height min(70vh,640px) (640 at 1700x1000, 490 at 1000x700). Measured fit zooms: standard hidden 0.785/0.492, shown 0.644/0.404; dense 0.15-0.238.
